name: tasquare
description: たすくえあ Tasquare · 方格 —— 黑格拼成互不共边的正方形区，圈内数字＝邻接黑区格数之和、? ＝至少邻一个黑格、白格全连通。裁判 countSolutions 穷举回答唯一性，铅笔 pencilSolve 零猜测回答可推性，两者对同一批候选方形说话。页面无构建、零依赖、无图片音频。

scripts.test: node tools/rule-test.mjs && node tools/counter-test.mjs && node tools/pencil-test.mjs && SAMPLES=24 node tools/balance.mjs
scripts.check: for f in $(find js tools \( -name '*.js' -o -name '*.mjs' -o -name '*.cjs' \)); do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && node --check server.cjs && echo OK
scripts.ci: npm run check && npm run wiring && npm test
